title: SAP Vigilance Clearance Management System
description: Enterprise SAP application for managing vigilance clearance requests, approvals, tracking and reporting.
longDescription: Developed an enterprise SAP Module Pool application for vigilance clearance lifecycle processing. Built custom screens, subscreens, interactive ALV reports, approval workflows, database tables, and Smart Forms integration with Open SQL.
keyFeatures: Interactive ALV reports for tracking clearance status
Custom ABAP Dictionary database tables & lock objects
Smart Forms generation for clearance documentation

title: Medical Claim Report
description: Interactive SAP ABAP ALV reporting solution for employee medical claim processing and status summaries.
longDescription: Developed an interactive SAP ABAP ALV report featuring dynamic selection screen filters, claim version tracking, claim cost summaries, optimized Open SQL joins, and data export features.
keyFeatures: Optimized Open SQL database queries & joins
Interactive ALV layout formatting & data export

title: ShopCraft - Microservices E-Commerce Platform
description: Distributed e-commerce platform built with independent microservices and RESTful API communications.
longDescription: Engineered an e-commerce architecture utilizing modular microservices for auth, catalog, orders, and notifications with Docker containerization and REST integrations.

title: DIYElectro - E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce web platform for electronic components with admin dashboard and order workflows.
longDescription: Built a full-featured online store with user authentication, OTP verification, inventory controls, cart management, checkout flows, and administrator management dashboard.
keyFeatures: Responsive UI built with EJS & Bootstrap

title: Employee Management System
description: Role-based web application for managing employee profiles, attendance records, and access permissions.
longDescription: Created an employee management platform featuring secure JWT authentication, role-based authorization, complete CRUD operations for employee records, and REST API integration.
keyFeatures: REST API endpoints with MongoDB persistence

title: ESP32 RFID Attendance System
description: IoT attendance capture system combining ESP32 RFID card reader hardware with a web management dashboard.
longDescription: Engineered an embedded RFID attendance logger using ESP32 hardware to capture card swipes and transmit attendance records to a Node.js backend and web dashboard.

title: 3D Printer Control & Automation
description: Embedded control system for custom 3D printer hardware, temperature regulation, and Marlin firmware tuning.
longDescription: Developed and configured custom 3D printer hardware control routines, stepper motor timing, hotend/bed temperature sensing, and serial protocol communication via Marlin firmware on Arduino.
